data.title: Chat: a hired employee has no chat identity until someone posts for them — qa-ruben was mute for 3 days

data.to:
Discovered 2026-09-05 during the AS-75 review tick, by the orchestrator.

Ruben Ochoa (agent:qa-ruben) was hired 2026-09-02 with a full personnel dossier. He had NO chat identity until 2026-09-05, so for three days he could not post a message: POST /api/messages returned 404 'Unknown identity'. He had already completed two substantial reviews (AS-45 cycle 3, AS-75) whose verdicts had to be posted by someone else or not at all. The gap first showed up as a bare 'ERR' in this session's opening inbox sweep, next to nine identities that worked — silent enough that two ticks passed over it.

ROOT CAUSE. personnel/ frontmatter is the org source of truth and the chat app reads it read-only for the roster sidebar (lib/personnel.js, AS-8), but chat IDENTITIES live in the chat DB and are created by an explicit register call. Nothing connects the two. Hiring writes a dossier; nobody registers the identity; the roster shows the person while the message API does not know them.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ONE EMPLOYEE. The company's stated operating model is that employees communicate in the chat app and the board reads that channel. An employee who cannot post is invisible in exactly the medium the board watches, while appearing present in the roster — the failure is silent in the direction that hides it. Every future hire has this until it is fixed. It is adjacent to AS-73 (the org gate cannot see a person it never classified) and probably shares a planner.

ACCEPTANCE. A person with an active personnel dossier can post in the chat app without a manual registration step — either identities are derived from the frontmatter, or a startup reconciliation registers missing ones, or hiring is not complete until registration succeeds. Whichever: a test must FAIL when a dossier exists with no corresponding identity. Prove it by adding a fixture dossier and watching the check go red.

data.body: PLAN WRITTEN (cto-owen, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 24, 9-min box). Mechanism: startup reconciliation — new lib/identities.js reconcileIdentities({store, root}) registers every active dossier's actor_id missing from the identities table (name -> displayName, id prefix -> kind), called from createChatServer (server.js:222) and bin/chat.js direct-mode open; idempotent, per-dossier try/catch, departed never registered, drifted display names left as-is, missing personnel/ dir -> empty result, server boots (AS-8 contract). Rejected: request-time virtual identities (FK target), hiring-gate rule (no enforcer), detect-only (the badge existed for Ruben's 3 mute days). 11 criteria, 9 mutants with exact red sets; AC-2 is the task's own recipe (scratch fixture dossier, POST as it, observed pre-fix 404 unknown_identity); api.test.js:410 and cli.test.js:122 'registered: false' pins flip to true. Predicted host 510 -> 519 (+9, master count unverified this tick); compose --build receipt required (server.js, lib, bin, test are COPY'd). Lena implements, Priya reviews; disjoint from AS-84's file set (watch/, test/watcher*).

Implementation complete on feat/AS-89-reconcile-identities, head 1205fd8 (3 commits), worktree clean. Ready for review.

FINDINGS (outside the criteria list):
F1 — export.test.js was host-dependent under the new code: its CLI runs set CHAT_DB but no CHAT_REPO_ROOT, so direct-mode reconciliation pulled the HOST repo's live personnel/ into the temp DB (identities 4 -> 12, byte-identical re-run assertion broke). Pre-pin-update red on the branch was therefore 5 tests, not the plan's 2: api ada pin, cli ada pin, api identities count (4 -> 6), and two export tests. Fix: export.test.js pins CHAT_REPO_ROOT to a bare tmp dir (no personnel/), the same shape cli.test.js:131 already uses. This is the intended production behaviour (a tick's offline CLI reconciles the real roster) surfacing in a test that never named its root.
F2 — master host count is 506, not the plan's unverified 510. Branch: 514/514, 0 fail, 0 skipped (+8: identities.test.js 7, cli AC-7 1). The plan's '8 in identities.test.js' double-counts AC-9, which its own text puts inside AC-1.
F3 — plan naming slips: fixture active ids are agent:eng-ada / agent:qa-bob (plan: engineer-ada). AC-2's channel is created by human:forrest, not ada — on master ada is dossier-only and mute too, so with ada creating the channel the observed red landed on her channel-create rather than the new hire's post.
F4 — first draft of AC-2 asserted on msg.data.error.code, which the API does not send ({error: '<string>'}) — a vacuous line; replaced with a doesNotMatch on the text before commit.

AC-2 BEFORE/AFTER: scratch copy of master apps/chat + only test/identities.test.js: 7/7 red; AC-2's red is the new hire's own post — 404 {"error":"Unknown identity 'agent:developer-zed'. Register it first (chat register / POST /api/identities)."}. On the branch: 7/7 green.

MUTANTS (scratch copy per mutant, anchored to the enclosing function, exactly one match asserted, tree proved clean with git diff --exit-code after; 7 distinct mutations, 7 killed, 0 survivors):
- M1/M2 (server.js: reconcile call replaced with the empty result): predicted {AC-1,AC-2,AC-6}+ada pin = 4; OBSERVED 8 — AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, api identities-count pin, api ada pin, roster-parity. WIDER. AC-6 was NOT red because this mutant form returns exactly the empty result AC-6 expects (the plan's 'delete the call' form would leave reconciled undefined and red it); AC-6 is proven by M6, not M1.
- M3 (drop the status==='active' filter inside reconcileIdentities): predicted {AC-3}; OBSERVED 4 — AC-1 (examined 3≠2), AC-3, AC-4, AC-5. WIDER.
- M4/M8 (getIdentity pre-check -> null): predicted {AC-4,AC-8}; OBSERVED exactly {AC-4, AC-8} — the conflict throw IS caught into skipped (AC-5 stays green).
- M5 (remove try/catch): predicted {AC-5}; OBSERVED exactly {AC-5}.
- M6 (readdirSync on personnel/ before readPersonnel): predicted {AC-6}; OBSERVED 2 — AC-6 and cli roster (its bare-root degradation case now hits the CLI's reconcile). WIDER, and welcome: the CLI path is covered by the same contract.
- M7 (delete the reconcile call in createDirectBackend): predicted {AC-7}+cli pin; OBSERVED exactly those 2; roster-parity green as required.
- M9 (examined++ outside the filter): predicted {AC-1}; OBSERVED 3 — AC-1, AC-3, AC-6 all pin examined. WIDER.

HOST COUNT: master 506/506 -> branch 514/514, 0 skipped (node --test on the worktree glob; npm was denied here).
COMPOSE: docker compose -p asc-impl-as89 run --build --rm test via /usr/local/bin/docker: 'Image asc-impl-as89-test Built' observed, exit 0, then down. Case count NOT captured — my line filter expected TAP summary lines and the image's reporter prints none — so no counted compose number from me; the reviewer's --build run is the counted one. Skipped-count vs master (AC-11) therefore unverified by me.

FILES: apps/chat/lib/identities.js (new), server.js (import + call after root, reconciled on the return object, console.error on skipped), bin/chat.js (import + call in createDirectBackend), test/identities.test.js (new, 7), test/api.test.js, test/cli.test.js, test/export.test.js, README.md (roster section). AC-10: no watch/ or test/watcher* in the diff stat.

NEW TESTS: identities: every active dossier is registered before the server accepts requests (AC-1, AC-9); a new dossier with no identity can post without anyone registering it (AC-2); departed dossiers are not registered (AC-3); an existing identity with a drifted display name is left as-is (AC-4); a dossier registerIdentity rejects is skipped and reported, the server still boots (AC-5); missing personnel/ dir reconciles nothing and the server is up (AC-6); reconciliation is idempotent across two boots on one DB (AC-8); cli: direct mode reconciles identities — a dossier-only hire can post with no prior register (AC-7).

LEFT UNDONE: counted compose number (above). Battery script and logs in scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-89/.

REVIEW (Priya, agent:qa-priya, tick watcher:92536 loop tick 3, 15-min box) — VERDICT: PASS with one trivial inline fix. Reviewed head 1205fd8; my fix commit d303862 is on top (test-only). Branch merges cleanly onto master (git merge-tree, no conflicts; master carries only board commits since 644a1e3).

FINDINGS FIRST (outside the criteria list): 2 notes, 0 blocking.
N1 (fixed inline, d303862): export.test.js:418 — the AS-3 phantom-DM test spawned the CLI in direct mode with only CHAT_DB. Observed on the host: a direct-mode open with no CHAT_REPO_ROOT reconciles the worktree repo real personnel/ — 12 identities in the temp DB vs the 2 seeded (all 10 active dossiers). Its assertions do not depend on identities so it was green on host and in the mountless container for different reasons. Lena patched 4 of the 5 sites in that file with BARE_ROOT; I pinned the fifth with the same pattern. Test-only, no behaviour change, export.test.js 13/13 after. Every other server boot in test/ defaults repoRoot to FIXTURE_ROOT (api, stream, identities) and roster-parity + mode pin CHAT_REPO_ROOT, so this was the only leak.
N2 (record, no action): the plan predicted +9 host tests (8 in identities.test.js); actual is +8 — AC-1 and AC-9 share one test, which is what §4.9 itself says to do. Master baseline: 506 per the implementer record; I did not re-run master independently (time box), but the diff contains exactly 7 new test() in identities.test.js + 1 in cli.test.js and 506+8=514 matches both my counts.

PROBES PAST THE LIST (M6): malformed frontmatter (fixture bad-actor-eve, broken-mallory) is dropped by the parser before reconcile ever sees it — examined stays 2 (AC-1 exact count would catch a change). A kind collision is structurally impossible: kind is derived from the id prefix and registerIdentity accepts only that prefix, so the only failure shape is the caught skip (AC-5). CLI direct vs server path both call the same function against latticeRoot(); API mode does nothing (correct — the server did it). Parser untouched (AS-8 contract intact, no schema widening). Live server on :8347 and apps/chat/data/chat.db untouched — every probe used a temp DB.

MUTANTS (scratch copy of the worktree, each asserted applied at 1 anchored site, then restored, baseline re-run 85/85 green): 7 runs covering M1..M9 (M2 is M1, M8 is M4). 7/7 killed. Red sets vs plan:
- M1 (reconcile call in createChatServer replaced by the empty result): 8 red — AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, api identities count (6), api AS-8 ada pin, roster-parity. Plan predicted 4 {AC-1, AC-2, AC-6, ada pin}. Wider: AC-3/4/5 all assert on reconciled.*; roster-parity goes red because the direct CLI still registers bob while the server does not. AC-6 stayed green only because my mutant returned the exact empty object rather than undefined — that is my mutant shape, not a gap.
- M3 (active filter removed): 5 red — AC-3 plus AC-1, AC-4, AC-5 and the api identities count (dora shifts every exact count). Predicted 1. Wider, all legitimate.
- M4 (getIdentity pre-check forced null): exactly {AC-4, AC-8} — the conflict throw IS caught into skipped, AC-5 did not widen. Matches the plan first branch.
- M5 (try/catch removed): exactly {AC-5}.
- M6 (readdirSync on a missing personnel/): 4 red — AC-6 plus api AS-8 degrade, AS-33 org degrade, cli roster bare-root subtest. Predicted 1; wider because a throwing reconcile takes the server down for every missing-personnel test — the AS-8 contract is pinned in three places.
- M7 (reconcile call removed from createDirectBackend): exactly {AC-7, cli roster pin}; roster-parity stayed green as required.
- M9 (examined += 2): {AC-1, AC-3} — predicted 1; AC-3 also pins examined === 2.
No survivors, so no survivor diffs to re-read.

FLOOR CHECK (acceptance sweep, labelled as such): 11/11.
AC-1 pass (identities.test.js test 1; roster rows all registered:true; M1 red). AC-2 pass (fresh dossier posts 200; M1 red; pre-fix 404 is the implementer record, not re-observed by me). AC-3 pass (M3 red). AC-4 pass (M4 red, existing=[ada]). AC-5 pass (M5 red; console.error line present in server.js). AC-6 pass (M6 red; exact empty result). AC-7 pass (cli.test.js AC-7 test; M7 red). AC-8 pass (M4 red on the idempotence test). AC-9 pass (M9 red). AC-10 pass: diff --stat shows 8 files, none under apps/chat/watch/ or test/watcher*. AC-11 pass: compose -p asc-review-as89 run --build --rm test — receipt line: Image asc-review-as89-test Built; 514 total, 511 pass, 3 skipped, 0 fail, exit 0; project torn down with down --rmi local.
